scope: programmable ULX3S 85F placement and routing experiments; not proof of unroutability
interpretation: All 35 execution cases and five compiled C cases pass on the current accelerated ABC9 system mapping. Physical routing is independent and incomplete. Congestion need not decrease monotonically. All four captured trials were interrupted after prolonged routing with unresolved congestion; none produced a routed circuit.
reproduction_note: Install pinned FPGA tools and prepare the standalone core mapping first. Production commands share build/loadable-ulx3s and must be run sequentially or in isolated copies. Experimental deeper RAM is not a production configuration.

historical_snapshot.note: Interrupted trials are not completed router failures. The production build directory has since been remapped; its old placed.json must not be combined with the new design.json.
